source_state: uncommitted cold retained target-module traversal and native physical inventory
behavior: The neutral parameter owner exposes immutable architecture/policy borrows and visits retained parameter values through the same replicated, routed and partitioned session driver.

Native resident policies enumerate current module values; bounded policies enumerate stored reload overrides without constructing or acquiring unloaded units. Active/pending unit ownership leaves inspection unavailable.
The session rejects unresolved, fenced or active transactions before visiting parameters, without establishing completion as a side effect.
Native target-module values enter RetainedStorage with exact completed allocation capacities, physical alias deduplication and retained old ownership across later replacement.

Both resident-policy constructors settle their weight transfer before returning loaded units. Synchronous manager acquisition finalizes array readiness before publishing resident storage, so cold inventory does not need completion work.

The parameter edit/restore fixture covers tied and untied models under resident, host-layerwise and disk-streamed execution with TP, PP and combined TP/PP. It verifies no source/materialization activity during cold inspection and compares prefill plus two decodes against independent ordinary edited execution.
The portable resident window rejects cold traversal while a unit is loaned, then permits it after return without constructing a unit.

Nine native configurations cover dense, tied and packed targets across three residency modes. Hidden checkpoint files do not prevent cold inspection or replacement inventory; adding the same replacement allocation does not increase its charge, restoring removes override ownership, and retained inventories survive executable teardown.
limits: This is the retained target-module and reload-override component. Source/residency buffers, addressable parameter banks, prediction modules, mutable state and escaped output handles still need composition.
The native inventory remains evidence rather than an automatic shared-pool reservation. Public native complete request quoting and admission are unfinished.
Unknown native backing remains unknown; no cold inspection evaluates a lazy graph or polls native completion.
Metadata, allocator caches, JIT and other process memory remain outside these physical payload bounds.
The current matrix validates parameter traversal and retention, not complete native inference budgets or new allocator/process peak measurements.
Builds retain the existing compact-unwind warning and native projection helpers awaiting full production admission integration.
